newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINNA TO TAKE OVER SAULES BANKA.
newsitem.headline: TALLINNA TO TAKE OVER SAULES BANKA.

text.p: Tallinna Pank said on Thursday it has in principle agreed to acquire 100 percent of the shares in Latvia's Saules Banka.
"We plan to increase our stake...to 100 percent," the bank's deputy chairman Targo Raus told a news conference.
He added that the agreement had been reached in principle.
Raus said the bank would not say anything about the agreement conditions as negotiations were still going on.
The goal waqs to reach an agreement by the end of this year, he added.
Tallinna Pank, the fourth largest bank in Estonia, last December bought 20 percent of shares in Saules Banka.
"We think Saules is the best partner in the Latvian market and the most favourable for us," Raus said.
Tallinna Pank board member Martti Siimman added that Saules Banka was one of the only banks in Latvia, which has been in profit from the beginning.
Raus added the bank will develop itself into an universal bank in the whole of the Baltics.
It also plans to start banking activities in Lithuania but no decisions have been made yet, he added.
